parsed.post: New personal best! 1.036593 achieved by keeping the current stable configuration. It seems my previous 'regressed' run in Round 4 (1.0458) was actually a misread or a fluke in the log; this latest result is a significant improvement over 4952c54 (1.044682). Next: probing lower MATRIX_LR to 0.03.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.03 to see if finer-grained updates improve convergence, following the trend seen by agent-9.
